purpose: Chapter 3.5 controlled educational experiments; not a reproduction of published headline scores

gnss.network: Upstream HybridShareSysNet; mask unused output for each ablation
gnss.solver: Batched four-step float64 Gauss-Newton with upstream TASGNSS cached satellite and atmospheric corrections
gnss.reference: SPAN to body to antenna using supplied lever arms and upstream attitude convention
gnss.test_policy: All finite reference-covered epochs with an available common GNSS frontend solution; no reference-error rejection; report frontend coverage

uwb.protocol: TDOA2; const1-3: trial1-3 complete recordings; const4: trial1-3, all three complete trajectories (nine test recordings)
uwb.network: Geometry-conditioned 10-64-64-1 MLP inspired by Zhao et al.; retrained on UTIL
uwb.features: Two anchor-to-tag vectors in body coordinates plus their azimuths and elevations; reference pose for training labels only; predicted ESKF pose at inference
uwb.backend: Upstream UTIL ESKF; retained 5-sigma gate; Huber threshold 1.345; same initialization and 8-fold per-pair sensor decimation for all variants; signed NN correction clipped to +/-2 m

io.tlio: Upstream ResNet1D [2,2,2,2], 200-sample window; 200-sample training stride; upstream stochastic-cloning EKF at 5 Hz
io.airio: Upstream CodeNetMotionwithRot, 1000-sample window and stride; causal endpoint velocity and covariance; conventional 15-state ESKF, not AirIMU
io.initialization: One reference position, velocity, attitude and bias state per sequence, shared by all methods; no later reference feedback
io.attitude_at_inference: Estimated from IMU and filter state; no continuous reference attitude
io.reference_version: Author IMU-only EuRoC release; V1_01 corrected OpenVINS reference where supplied separately
io.alignment: None; relative displacement error also reported

figures.layout: one axes per figure, no subfigures
